svg.aria-label: Left: the suite's compose project with its services and ports. Right: the IA Next compose project with the ia-next container on 127.0.0.1:9400, the renderer with no host port, and the ia-next-data volume. A dashed arrow shows IA Next calling the HiC proxy on port 5012 through the host.
